aboutChannelInfo.channelDescription:
Chronofold folds thousands of years into fifteen minutes.

Most countries only reach us as headlines. But behind every one of them 
sits a story that runs for millennia — empires that rose and vanished, 
cities that were once the richest places on earth, and turning points 
that explain exactly why the world looks the way it does today.

Every video is a complete history, start to present day, in one sitting.

Subscribe and you won't miss the next one.

Got a country you want covered? Leave it in the comments. That's how 
we choose.

New videos regularly.

became the graveyard of empires, this was the richest crossroads on Earth.

The complete history, from the lapis mines of 4000 BC to 2021.

text:
How did a handful of poor mountain valleys become the richest, safest country in Europe? This is the ENTIRE history of Switzerland in 15 minutes, from the Gotthard Pass and the 1291 alliance to Swiss mercenaries, Napoleon, the Red Cross, two world wars, Nazi gold and the end of Swiss bank secrecy.
